title: Cohomology bounds and finite constant models from one perfect chart
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be an immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$ over the completed coefficient sheaf $B_X$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $U\in Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Suppose the restriction to $U$ of $g^*K$ is isomorphic to that of $g^*(B_X\otimes_{\underline A}^L\underline P)$ for a perfect $A$-complex $P$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex, def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-complex-base, def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models]. Then there exist integers $a\le b$ such that the restrictions to $U$ of $g^*\mathcal H^q(K)$ and of $g^*\operatorname{Res}_{j_n}\mathcal H^q(K\otimes_{B_X}^LR_n)$ vanish for every $q\notin[a,b]$ and every $n\ge0$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Here $R_n$ and $j_n:\underline{A/I^{n+1}}\simeq R_n$ are the specified quotient coefficients and constant comparison. For every $n,q$ there is a finite $A/I^{n+1}$-module $M$ and an isomorphism on the same $U$ between the latter cohomology restriction and the restriction of $g^*\underline M$.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.8(1); Lemma 6.6.10(1); Proposition 6.6.11, reverse implication, local perfect models

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective representative C of the perfect complex P. Exact constant realization transports its derived isomorphism to the chosen representative used in the hypothesis. The constant C is K-flat by projective flatness and bounded-above flatness; the universal extension counit identifies the completed model with the termwise extension complex.

Apply the chart tensor comparison for every n. It identifies the normalized finite reduction on the original chart with the constant quotient tensor complex. Exact geometric inverse image and exact slice restriction commute with derived homology; the ring-isomorphism scalar comparison identifies the identity-coefficient pullback with module inverse image.

Enlarge the support bounds of C to contain zero. Constants, scalar extension, and quotient tensor preserve zero terms, so the completed and all quotient tensor complexes vanish in every degree outside that same interval. A zero term gives zero homology in that degree; transport this along the preceding isomorphisms.

Exact constants commute with homology. A quotient tensor term is finitely generated over the finite quotient ring, hence is a finite set. Its cycles embed into that finite term and its homology is a quotient of the cycles, so the homology module is finite. Its constant realization is the required model, by the homology comparisons.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 6.5.8(1); Lemma 6.6.10(1); Proposition 6.6.11, reverse implication, local perfect models; explicit scalar-adjunction and exact-homology calculation, B2

theorem perfect_local_reduction_models
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (K : d.derived X) (U : Y.ProEt)
    (P : @DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) _ _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _))
    (hP : @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex A _ (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) P)
    (e : Nonempty (integralLocalDerived g (d.completedRing X) U K ≅
      integralLocalDerived g (d.completedRing X) U
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (CompletedConstantReduction.base X d.ideal ≫
          (pbcCompletedComparison X d).hom)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((CompletedConstantReduction.constantComplex X A).obj
              ((@DerivedCategory.Q (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) _ _
                (HasDerivedCategory.standard _)).objPreimage P)))))) :
    ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).obj
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g (d.completedRing X)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)))) ∧
      (∀ n q, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).obj
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
            (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
              ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((d.reduction X n).obj K)))))) ∧
      ∀ n q, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)), Finite M ∧
        Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).obj
          ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
            (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
              ((pbcRestrict (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((d.reduction X n).obj K)))) ≅
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ U).obj
            ((proEtaleModuleInverseImage g
              (adicLisseConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))).obj
                ((adicLisseConstantModules X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).obj M)))
